articles.title: How to make a jewellery bill
articles.summary: Step by step: type the day's rates, add each ornament with gross, stone and net weight, making charges and GST, take old gold in exchange, then print or share the bill.

articles.title: Stock by weight in grams
articles.summary: Keep jewellery stock in grams for each metal and purity: add opening stock, sales reduce it, old gold taken in adds to it, and see the pure metal in hand.
